subject: Re: CogniWare short extension — structure options (timebox top-up vs prepay)
messages:
From: Sam Morris <sam.morris@cogniware.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: 3-week top-up and pricing options for current timebox

Markus —

Thanks again for the fast onboarding this month. We ramped two ingestion pipelines and have a clear signal we need an extra 3 weeks to finish the evaluation (mainly model-to-prod smoke tests). Before I ask legal to sign anything, can you confirm which of these two options would be easier for CogniWare and what discounts apply?

1) Timebox top-up: add 3 calendar weeks to the existing POC term, same SKU, billed pro-rata at our current trial rate.
2) Prepay bucket: buy a 50k token surge bucket at a discounted prepay price, usable during either the original term or the extra 3 weeks.

We attached today's usage snapshot for context. Our procurement prefers a single invoice and minimal contract paperwork. If you can share an addendum draft and approximate numbers, I can move this quickly.

Attachments: CogniWare_POC_usage_20270301.csv (token breakdown)

Cheers,
Sam Morris
Head of ML, CogniWare
sam.morris@cogniware.io
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Morris <sam.morris@cogniware.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week top-up and pricing options for current timebox

Sam —

Appreciate the early heads-up and the usage file — helps a lot. High level response below, then I'll attach a short addendum you can share with procurement.

Quick summary:
- Timebox top-up (3 weeks): simplest operationally. We can extend the current POC by 21 days and invoice a pro-rata charge equal to the trial SKU daily rate * 21 days. No change to SLAs or support.
- Prepay surge bucket (50k tokens): slightly more paperwork (amendment + prepaid invoice) but gives you token flexibility; we can price the bucket at a ~15% discount vs run-rate token pricing if you commit to immediate payment.

A third hybrid option we sometimes use (recommended if procurement wants one invoice + lower admin):
- Short addendum that converts unused top-up dollars into a token credit usable within 90 days. That keeps the paperwork light and gives CogniWare both runway and flexibility.

If procurement needs a single invoice and minimal signatures, the top-up + credit-conversion clause is the fastest. I drafted a one-page addendum and exported a pricing matrix — attaching both.

Proposed next steps:
1) Track which option you prefer (Top-up | Prepay bucket | Hybrid).
2) If Top-up or Hybrid: we send one-page addendum for signature, invoice for pro-rata days.
3) If Prepay: we send purchase order + invoice for bucket; funds must clear before bucket is active.

Attachments: POC_Addendum_MK_v1.docx, redwood_pricing_matrix.pdf

If you want, I can loop in Prio (Prio is priyom_das in our thread) on implementation specifics for credits mapping to usage events.

— Markus Klein
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CogniWare short extension — structure options (timebox top-up vs prepay)

Markus — quick internal note. I reviewed the pricing matrix. For this level of engagement (early-stage POC, likely close to a mid-market expansion), I'm comfortable approving a hybrid: 21-day top-up invoiced pro-rata + 12% conversion credit if they buy the 50k token bucket within 30 days after the extended term.

Key constraints:
- Discount cap 12% (above that needs VP sign-off).
- Addendum must include clause: unused top-up dollars convert to token credit (not refundable) and expire after 90 days.
- No SLA changes; keep support as-is.

Priyo — can you confirm operational flow for credit issuance and mapping? Happy to have you reply with a short checklist we can include in the addendum so procurement sees minimal ops risk.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Morris <sam.morris@cogniware.io>
Cc: Ben Cline <ben@cogniware.io>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Extension addendum and hybrid offer (three-week top-up + conversion credit)

Sam / Ben —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per Laura's guidance, we've finalized a short addendum that implements the hybrid approach:

- 21-calendar-day top-up to current POC term; invoiced pro-rata at current trial SKU rate.
- If CogniWare purchases a 50k token prepay within 30 days after the extended term, Redwood will apply a 12% conversion credit to that purchase (applied as immediate token credit on activation).
- Unused top-up dollars (if any) convert to token credits and expire after 90 days. No refunds.

I've attached the one-page PDF addendum and the redlined pricing matrix for procurement. If this matches your needs, please:
1) Reply with PO number or a signed addendum (DocuSign link included).
2) We'll issue the pro-rata invoice the same day the signed addendum or PO is received.

DocuSign: https://docusign.redwood.ai/sigs/POC-ADD-4531
Attachments: POC_Addendum_MK_v1.docx, redwood_pricing_matrix.pdf

If procurement still insists on a single invoice for everything, we can bundle but need written confirmation they'd accept the non-refundable credit conversion clause.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to walk procurement through the flow.

— Markus
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
